card.name: The word dose as a study modifier
card.fires_on: The word "dose" when it begins a compound modifier such as dose-escalation, dose-finding, dose-limiting or dose-related, usually in overdosage or trial descriptions.

card.writes: It pushes toward words like reaction, response and modification, which fit "dose-response" style compounds.
card.plain: It fires on "dose" when it opens a phrase like dose-escalation or dose-limiting, where a word like response could come next.
